meta.title: LUT使用的小秘诀：放链路开头还是结尾？
meta.title_en: LUT Secrets: Front of the Chain or at the End?

scenes.title_cn: 两种 LUT 用法：放开头还是结尾
scenes.title_en: Two Ways to Use a LUT: Front or End
scenes.context: 有人把 LUT 放在调色链路最开头，之后再校色。这是最常见的做法之一，但调色师随即给出一个警告：这可能很危险。
sentences: 有人把 LUT 放在调色链路的最开始，在它之后再做校色。
Some people use a LUT at the very beginning of their chain and color correct after it.
color chain（调色链路）
这可能有危险。
This can be dangerous.
dangerous（危险的）
这是一次对一个范围很大的问题的回答。
This is a response to a very overarching question.
overarching（范围很大的）
paraphrase: Some grade with the LUT up front, then correct on top.
A word of caution before you pick a side.
scenes.speak: Some people use a LUT at the very beginning of their chain and color correct after it. This can be dangerous. This is a response to a very overarching question.

scenes.title_cn: 开头的风险：显示器看不到的色会在 P3 里显形
scenes.title_en: The Risk: Invisible Colors Can Surface in P3
scenes.context: 如果影片最终要在 DCI P3 色域的投影机播放，显示器上看不到的颜色可能在 P3 里突然显现。对策是在链路末尾加 DCI P3 limiter，把色彩约束在交付色域内。
sentences: 有些颜色在你的显示器上看不见，却会在 P3 色域里突然表达出来。
There are colors you can't see on your monitor that suddenly express themselves in P3.
express themselves（显现出来）
我建议在链路末尾放一个限制器。
I always think it's good to put a limiter at the end of your chain.
limiter（限制器）
DCI P3 限制器确保你工作在受约束的色彩空间里。
A DCI P3 limiter makes certain you're working in a constrained color space.
constrained color space（受约束的色彩空间）
paraphrase: Your monitor is hiding colors that the projector will reveal.
Add a safety net so your final deliverable stays in spec.
scenes.speak: There are colors you can't see on your monitor that suddenly express themselves in P3. I always think it's good to put a limiter at the end of your chain. A DCI P3 limiter makes certain you're working in a constrained color space.

scenes.title_cn: 作者习惯：LUT 放链路末尾，先校色后套 LUT
scenes.title_en: My Habit: LUT at the End, Correct First
scenes.context: 作者个人倾向把 LUT 放在链路末尾：先校色、后套 LUT，全程知道自己调色板的约束、对比曲线与最终色彩，非常省时且清晰。两种方式都成立。
sentences: 我个人倾向于把 LUT 放在链路末尾。
I personally tend to work with a LUT at the end of my chain.
tend to（倾向于）
我知道我这个调色板的约束。
I know the constraints of my palette.
palette（调色板）
这非常省时，而且在色彩和对比值上非常清晰。
It's very time-efficient, and it's very clear in terms of colors and contrast values.
time-efficient（省时的）
paraphrase: 「知道自己色板的边界」换种说法
I know exactly how far my color palette can go.
For me it's the fastest, clearest way to work.
scenes.speak: I personally tend to work with a LUT at the end of my chain. I know the constraints of my palette. It's very time-efficient, and it's very clear in terms of colors and contrast values.

practice: 「LUT 放在链路开头还是结尾？」怎么说？
Should the LUT go at the front or the end of the chain?
「显示器看不到的色」怎么表达？
Colors you can't see on your monitor.
「保护交付色域」用英文怎么说？
Grade first, then apply the LUT.
pitfalls: Place the LUT up front with no safety net.
Add a DCI P3 limiter at the end of the chain.
Without a limiter, hidden colors can blow out in the P3 projector.
Trust your monitor for final color.
Verify in your target color space.
Your monitor can't show every color your deliverable can.
Treat LUT placement as pure taste.
Treat it as a workflow decision tied to your color space.
Placement is about managing color-space risk, not preference.
Forget to check the final deliverable.
Confirm your output stays inside the intended color space.
The whole point is a clean, predictable final deliverable.
shifts: 以为 LUT 只能放一个固定位置
理解 LUT 位置与色域管理要配套
用限制器与交付色域确认最终输出
把摆放当风险管理问题
